# Siddharth Singh

> Senior Software Engineer (full-stack) in New York, NY, building AI agent platforms, distributed systems, and the infrastructure that runs them. Currently a Software Developer at Arvo AI. MS in Computer Science from New York University (2025). 4+ years of experience across cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and AI agent platforms.

This site (https://isiddharthsingh.netlify.app/) is a single-page app with hash routing — section URLs below use `#/`. Contact: sms10221@nyu.edu · GitHub: https://github.com/isiddharthsingh · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/isiddharthsingh

## Experience

- Arvo AI — Software Developer (Dec 2025–present, New York): AI-powered incident root-cause-analysis platform — a LangGraph ReAct agent running 240-step reasoning across 40+ tools and 4 LLM providers; multi-cloud integrations across 5 cloud providers and 15 monitoring platforms with credential-isolated execution; an alert-correlation engine on Memgraph; 3-collection RAG with episodic agent memory on Weaviate; a multi-agent orchestrator running parallel hypotheses.
- Kamen Yotov — Software Developer (Jun 2025–Dec 2025, New York): AI productivity assistant integrating Slack, Trello, Gmail, and Google Calendar; cut manual coordination by ~50%.
- NY Wealth Planning Group (ISAC) — Software Developer (Jul 2025–Dec 2025, New York): owned the ISAC site — landing pages, webinar pages with registration and filtering, WhatsApp automation, volunteer databases.
- Futeur AI — Software Developer (Feb 2025–May 2025, New York): Next.js microservices with CI/CD; post-quantum cryptography (CRYSTALS-Kyber/Dilithium) database integration; security platform integrating OSSEC HIDS, Wazuh, and Suricata; distributed logging on Hyperledger Fabric.
- NYU — Web Developer (Sep 2024–May 2025, New York): department and faculty sites on Java + React.
- Cognizant — Cloud Engineer (Jul 2021–Aug 2023, Hyderabad): scalable GCP infrastructure (Compute Engine, GKE); CI/CD on Cloud Build, Cloud Run, and Terraform; ETL on Dataflow and BigQuery; IAM/VPC security hardening.

## Education

- MS Computer Science, New York University (Sep 2023–May 2025), CGPA 3.72/4.0

Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, C, C++, C#, .NET, SQL. AI/agents: LangGraph, Weaviate, Memgraph, OpenAI, PyTorch, RAG, ReAct. Cloud/infra: GCP, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CircleCI, HashiCorp Vault, LiveKit. Data: BigQuery, Redshift, CockroachDB, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Postgres, Cassandra, Redis. Streaming/web: Kafka, Spark, React, Next.js, Node. Certifications: Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, Google Associate Cloud Engineer, Deep Learning.
